purpose: Chest Imaging Platform (CIP) extension for 3D Slicer providing quantitative CT imaging biomarkers and analysis tools for lung diseases.
summary: The Chest Imaging Platform (SlicerCIP) extension is well-structured, follows Slicer CMake and Python conventions, includes a valid BSD 3-Clause license, and presents no safety or environment concerns. 🟢 Recommend merge

safety.rationale: No malicious code, network exfiltration, or unsafe operations found.

environment.rationale: No modification of shared Python environment or package pinning detected.

packaging.rationale: CMake configuration builds loadable and scripted modules correctly according to Slicer standards.

license.rationale: Standard BSD 3-Clause license provided in LICENSE file.

soundness.rationale: Follows Slicer scripted and loadable module conventions properly.

utility.rationale: Well-established Slicer extension for chest imaging analysis with comprehensive modules and documentation.

findings.title: Unused attic code and binaries included
findings.explanation: The repository contains a large amount of unused/attic code, including old Google Picasa API integrations and WinSCP binaries, which adds unnecessary weight and clutter.
findings.suggestion: Remove unused attic directories and binaries from the repository.

not_checked: Full runtime execution of C++ loadable modules and external CIP library compilation.
